usageNotes: Lists all ACME accounts registered on the cluster, returning their names as child links. Use this before issuing certificate operations to confirm which ACME account names are available; the names returned here are the values expected by certificate-related endpoints that require an account reference. No privileges beyond basic authentication are required.

examples.summary: List all registered ACME accounts on the cluster

tips: The response is a name-index only — each entry links to a child resource; fetch individual accounts via get_cluster_acme_account_name to retrieve full details such as directory URL and contact email.
An empty array means no ACME accounts have been configured yet; you must create one before requesting certificates.
API tokens are supported (allowtoken: true), so automation scripts can safely call this endpoint without a full user session.
